CATCHES: implementations that ignore the -cbin parameter (angle bin width), fail to
adjust cos(theta) histogram resolution, produce identical angular distributions for
different -cbin values, or crash on very small/large angle bin widths.

CATCHES: implementations that fail basic solvation with default SPC water
model - they would exit non-zero, fail to create the output structure file,
produce an empty or truncated structure file, or not add any solvent molecules
to a system with plenty of available space.

CATCHES: implementations that fail to apply PBC correctly in mindist calculations,
produce wrong minimum distances near box boundaries, or ignore -pbc/-nopbc flags.

Golden files: mindist_with_pbc.xvg.golden -- minimum distance with PBC
